description: The whole authored definition of a map: what it is called, which build and dependencies it expects, and every unit, building, weapon, ability, item and cosmetic template it ships.

license.title: license
license.description: The licence the map's content is published under, stored as an exact URL so the same licence text is agreed to by everybody who downloads the map.

GameBuildNumber.title: GameBuildNumber
GameBuildNumber.description: The Realm build the map was authored and published against. A lobby only offers the map to a build that matches it exactly.

MapProperties.title: MapProperties
MapProperties.description: Everything the map says about itself to a player: its name, its author, its size, its lighting and the slots it offers.

MapName.title: MapName
MapName.description: The title the map is listed under in the lobby.

MapDescription.title: MapDescription
MapDescription.description: The short introduction shown beside the map in the lobby.

Author.title: Author
Author.description: The name the map credits as its author.

SuggestedPlayers.title: SuggestedPlayers
SuggestedPlayers.description: How many players the map is designed for, written as text such as 2-4.

MinimapImage.title: MinimapImage
MinimapImage.description: Path to the image drawn in the lobby's minimap panel for this map.

ShroudType.title: ShroudType
ShroudType.description: The kind of fog of war the match uses, such as unexplored shroud or visible-only fog.

WeatherType.title: WeatherType
WeatherType.description: The weather the match starts with, which the weather system animates from.

TerrainBaseHeight.title: TerrainBaseHeight
TerrainBaseHeight.description: The height the flat parts of the map sit at before terrain is sculpted.

ShadowIntensity.title: ShadowIntensity
ShadowIntensity.description: How dark the shadows the sun casts are.

MapWidth.title: MapWidth
MapWidth.description: The width of the map in terrain cells.

MapHeight.title: MapHeight
MapHeight.description: The depth of the map in terrain cells.

PlayableWidth.title: PlayableWidth
PlayableWidth.description: The width of the area a match is actually played in, in terrain cells.

PlayableHeight.title: PlayableHeight
PlayableHeight.description: The depth of the area a match is actually played in, in terrain cells.

CameraBoundsLeft.title: CameraBoundsLeft
CameraBoundsLeft.description: The west edge of the area the camera may pan to.

CameraBoundsRight.title: CameraBoundsRight
CameraBoundsRight.description: The east edge of the area the camera may pan to.

CameraBoundsTop.title: CameraBoundsTop
CameraBoundsTop.description: The north edge of the area the camera may pan to.

CameraBoundsBottom.title: CameraBoundsBottom
CameraBoundsBottom.description: The south edge of the area the camera may pan to.

LoadingImage.title: LoadingImage
LoadingImage.description: Path to the picture the loading screen shows while this map loads.

LoadingMusic.title: LoadingMusic
LoadingMusic.description: Path to the music played while this map loads.

LoadingTitle.title: LoadingTitle
LoadingTitle.description: The heading the loading screen shows over the map's name.

LoadingSubtitle.title: LoadingSubtitle
LoadingSubtitle.description: The line the loading screen shows under the map's name.

LoadingBodyText.title: LoadingBodyText
LoadingBodyText.description: The body text the loading screen shows while the map loads, which a map uses to set the scene.

HowToPlayObjective.title: HowToPlayObjective
HowToPlayObjective.description: What the map asks the player to do, shown in the how-to-play panel.

Version.title: Version
Version.description: The version the map author gives this map, which the lobby shows beside the name.

Changelog.title: Changelog
Changelog.description: The changes the map has been through, newest first, shown in the map's details.

items.description: One entry of a map's changelog: which version changed, when, and what changed in it.

Date.title: Date
Date.description: The date the version was published, written the way the author wants it shown.

Details.title: Details
Details.description: What changed in this version, in the author's own words.

PlayerSlots.title: PlayerSlots
PlayerSlots.description: The slots the map offers, each with its own colour, faction and controller.

items.description: One seat a map offers: which slot it is, what it is called and who may take it.

SlotId.title: SlotId
SlotId.description: The slot number a team's slot list and a placed unit refer to.

Name.title: Name
Name.description: The name the slot shows in the lobby instead of a player name.

Color.title: Color
Color.description: The colour the slot's units, minimap markers and selection rings are drawn in.

Faction.title: Faction
Faction.description: The faction the slot plays, which decides which templates it may train.

Controller.title: Controller
Controller.description: Whether the slot is taken by a person or played by the computer.

AiType.title: AiType
AiType.description: Which computer player personality fills the slot when it is played by the computer.

StartLocation.title: StartLocation
StartLocation.description: The named coordinate the slot's starting units are placed at.

CustomDecal.title: CustomDecal
CustomDecal.description: The decal drawn on the ground under the slot's starting area.

Teams.title: Teams
Teams.description: The teams the slots are grouped into for a match on this map.

items.description: One team a map seats players on, which decides who is allied with whom.

TeamName.title: TeamName
TeamName.description: The name the team shows in the lobby and on the scoreboard.

Slots.title: Slots
Slots.description: The slots that make up the team. Slots on the same team start allied.

Tags.title: Tags
Tags.description: The labels the lobby filters maps by, such as melee, co-op or tower defence.

MapType.title: MapType
MapType.description: The kind of map this is, such as melee, campaign or asset pack.

TestAiPlayerCount.title: TestAiPlayerCount
TestAiPlayerCount.description: How many computer players a test run fills the empty slots with.

TestRandomizeSlots.title: TestRandomizeSlots
TestRandomizeSlots.description: Whether a test run fills the empty slots with computer players in a random order instead of the map's own.

TestRandomSeed.title: TestRandomSeed
TestRandomSeed.description: The seed a test run uses for anything random, so the same run can be repeated.

PlayablePlayerSlots.title: PlayablePlayerSlots
PlayablePlayerSlots.description: How many players a match on this map may seat.

ShowUnitHealthBar.title: ShowUnitHealthBar
ShowUnitHealthBar.description: Whether units draw a health bar above them.

ShowUnitManaBar.title: ShowUnitManaBar
ShowUnitManaBar.description: Whether units draw a mana bar under their health bar.

ShowUnitLevel.title: ShowUnitLevel
ShowUnitLevel.description: Whether units the script gives an overhead badge to draw it to the left of their overhead bars.

InventorySlots.title: InventorySlots
InventorySlots.description: How many inventory slots every unit may fill. Relics and other equipment take slots the way a gathered piece does, so this bounds what a unit can carry home. Absent means six.

Dependencies.title: Dependencies
Dependencies.description: Other published maps this map builds on. Their content is merged into this one before the map's own templates are resolved.

items.description: Another published map this map builds on, pinned to the version and content hash its author expects.

Id.title: Id
Id.description: The identifier the dependency is published under.

Name.title: Name
Name.description: The name the dependency is listed under, shown to the author.

Version.title: Version
Version.description: The exact version of the dependency this map was authored against.

Hash.title: Hash
Hash.description: The content hash of the dependency this map was authored against, so the same bytes are merged.

IsOptional.title: IsOptional
IsOptional.description: Whether the map still loads when the dependency cannot be found.

Url.title: Url
Url.description: Where the dependency may be downloaded from when it is not already installed.

Templates.title: Templates
Templates.description: Every unit, building, prop, resource, ability, weapon, upgrade, item, consumable, attachment and visual effect the map defines.

Units.title: Units
Units.description: The units a player trains and orders around.

items.description: One unit or building template: its combat stats, its price, what it can build, cast and carry, and how it moves, dies and sounds.

MaxHp.title: MaxHp
MaxHp.description: Health the unit starts with and can never exceed before upgrades.

Damage.title: Damage
Damage.description: Damage one attack deals before the target's armour, resistances and the map's combat tuning are applied.

Range.title: Range
Range.description: How far the unit can reach with its weapon, measured from its edge to the target's edge.

Armor.title: Armor
Armor.description: Flat damage reduction applied to every physical hit the unit takes.

Speed.title: Speed
Speed.description: How fast the unit crosses the ground under its own orders.

AttackCooldown.title: AttackCooldown
AttackCooldown.description: How long the unit waits between attacks.

ScanRadius.title: ScanRadius
ScanRadius.description: How far from its post the unit looks for something to attack on its own.

CostGold.title: CostGold
CostGold.description: Gold the unit costs to train.

CostWood.title: CostWood
CostWood.description: Wood the unit costs to train.

CostStone.title: CostStone
CostStone.description: Stone the unit costs to train.

PopCost.title: PopCost
PopCost.description: How much of its owner's population the unit occupies while it is alive.

ProductionTime.title: ProductionTime
ProductionTime.description: How long the producing building takes to train the unit.

Strength.title: Strength
Strength.description: The unit's strength attribute, which the map's combat tuning turns into attack and armour.

Agility.title: Agility
Agility.description: The unit's agility attribute, which the map's combat tuning turns into attack and movement speed.

Vitality.title: Vitality
Vitality.description: The unit's vitality attribute, which the map's combat tuning turns into health and mana.

Intelligence.title: Intelligence
Intelligence.description: The unit's intelligence attribute, which the map's combat tuning turns into spell power and mana regeneration.

Wisdom.title: Wisdom
Wisdom.description: The unit's wisdom attribute, which the map's combat tuning turns into magic penetration and healing.

Fortune.title: Fortune
Fortune.description: The unit's fortune attribute, which the map's combat tuning turns into crit chance, evasion and bounty.

LevelGrowth.title: LevelGrowth
LevelGrowth.description: How much each attribute and the bounty multiplier gain for every level the unit reaches.

StrengthPerLevel.title: StrengthPerLevel
StrengthPerLevel.description: How much strength the unit gains per level.

AgilityPerLevel.title: AgilityPerLevel
AgilityPerLevel.description: How much agility the unit gains per level.

VitalityPerLevel.title: VitalityPerLevel
VitalityPerLevel.description: How much vitality the unit gains per level.

IntelligencePerLevel.title: IntelligencePerLevel
IntelligencePerLevel.description: How much intelligence the unit gains per level.

WisdomPerLevel.title: WisdomPerLevel
WisdomPerLevel.description: How much wisdom the unit gains per level.

FortunePerLevel.title: FortunePerLevel
FortunePerLevel.description: How much fortune the unit gains per level.

BountyMultiplierPerLevel.title: BountyMultiplierPerLevel
BountyMultiplierPerLevel.description: How much the gold and experience a killer is paid for this unit grows per level.

HpRegen.title: HpRegen
HpRegen.description: Health the unit regains per second while it is out of combat.

HpRegenCombatDelay.title: HpRegenCombatDelay
HpRegenCombatDelay.description: How long the unit has to stay out of combat before health regeneration resumes.

MaxMana.title: MaxMana
MaxMana.description: Mana the unit starts with and can never exceed before upgrades.

ManaRegen.title: ManaRegen
ManaRegen.description: Mana the unit regains per second.

MagicResistance.title: MagicResistance
MagicResistance.description: Flat reduction applied to every magical hit the unit takes.

FlatArmorPenetration.title: FlatArmorPenetration
FlatArmorPenetration.description: Armour points the unit's attacks ignore outright.

PercentArmorPenetration.title: PercentArmorPenetration
PercentArmorPenetration.description: The share of the target's armour the unit's attacks ignore.

FlatMagicPenetration.title: FlatMagicPenetration
FlatMagicPenetration.description: Magic resistance points the unit's spells ignore outright.

DamageVariance.title: DamageVariance
DamageVariance.description: How far either side of the listed damage an attack may land, so the same unit does not hit for an identical number every time.

DamageType.title: DamageType
DamageType.description: Whether the unit's damage is mitigated as physical or as magical.

CritChance.title: CritChance
CritChance.description: The chance an attack crits, as a fraction of one.

CritMultiplier.title: CritMultiplier
CritMultiplier.description: What a crit multiplies the attack's damage by.

SplashType.title: SplashType
SplashType.description: How the unit's attacks spread over several targets, or None when every attack hits one target only.

SplashInnerRadius.title: SplashInnerRadius
SplashInnerRadius.description: The radius inside which a splashing attack deals its full inner share of damage.

SplashMediumRadius.title: SplashMediumRadius
SplashMediumRadius.description: The radius inside which a splashing attack deals its medium share of damage.

SplashOuterRadius.title: SplashOuterRadius
SplashOuterRadius.description: The radius outside which a splashing attack deals no damage at all.

SplashInnerRatio.title: SplashInnerRatio
SplashInnerRatio.description: The share of the attack's damage dealt to targets inside the inner splash radius.

SplashMediumRatio.title: SplashMediumRatio
SplashMediumRatio.description: The share of the attack's damage dealt to targets between the inner and medium splash radii.

SplashOuterRatio.title: SplashOuterRatio
SplashOuterRatio.description: The share of the attack's damage dealt to targets between the medium and outer splash radii.

FriendlyFire.title: FriendlyFire
FriendlyFire.description: Whether the unit's splash damages its own side as well as the enemy's.

PushPriority.title: PushPriority
PushPriority.description: Which unit gives way when two of them push each other, higher values winning.

MovementType.title: MovementType
MovementType.description: Whether the unit walks, flies or is fixed in place, which decides which terrain it may cross.

SightRange.title: SightRange
SightRange.description: How far the unit sees, which is the range its fog of war is lifted over.

AcquisitionRange.title: AcquisitionRange
AcquisitionRange.description: How far away the unit notices an enemy and decides to engage it without being ordered to.

GoldBounty.title: GoldBounty
GoldBounty.description: Gold the killer's owner is paid for destroying the unit.

RespawnSeconds.title: RespawnSeconds
RespawnSeconds.description: How long the unit stays down before it revives at its owner's start location. Zero means it stays dead.

BuildOptions.title: BuildOptions
BuildOptions.description: The buildings a worker may raise, as a selection of unit and building templates.

IsHero.title: IsHero
IsHero.description: Whether the unit is a hero: it levels up, revives and is shown separately in the interface.

IncludeInDefaultHotkeySelection.title: IncludeInDefaultHotkeySelection
IncludeInDefaultHotkeySelection.description: Whether the unit joins the selection a player gets by dragging a box over their army.

Abilities.title: Abilities
Abilities.description: The abilities that appear on the unit's command card.

XpBounty.title: XpBounty
XpBounty.description: Experience the killer's owner is awarded for destroying the unit.

ExperiencePerLevel.title: ExperiencePerLevel
ExperiencePerLevel.description: Experience the unit needs to reach its next level, before any per-level growth is applied.

MaxLevel.title: MaxLevel
MaxLevel.description: The highest level the unit may reach. One means it never levels.

Level.title: Level
Level.description: The level the unit starts the match at.

PathingCapabilities.title: PathingCapabilities
PathingCapabilities.description: The kinds of terrain the unit may cross, which narrows what its movement type allows.

Targets.title: Targets
Targets.description: The kinds of target the unit may attack, such as ground units, air units or structures.

Weapons.title: Weapons
Weapons.description: The weapons the unit attacks with. Several weapons are fired in the order they are listed.

ProjectileModelPath.title: ProjectileModelPath
ProjectileModelPath.description: Path to the model flown by the unit's projectile when its weapon has no model of its own.

Animations.title: Animations
Animations.description: The model animations the unit plays, keyed by the state that asks for them such as idle, walk or attack.

ObjectAttachments.title: ObjectAttachments
ObjectAttachments.description: Which attachments sit on which hand or named socket of the unit's model.

right_hand.title: right_hand
right_hand.description: The attachments carried in the model's right hand, one alternative per entry.

additionalProperties.description: How one attachment is placed on the socket it is carried on, both where it sits and how it is turned and scaled.

PositionX.title: PositionX
PositionX.description: How far the attachment is moved along the socket's sideways axis.

PositionY.title: PositionY
PositionY.description: How far the attachment is moved up or down from the socket.

PositionZ.title: PositionZ
PositionZ.description: How far the attachment is moved along the socket's forward axis.

PitchX.title: PitchX
PitchX.description: How far the attachment is tipped forwards or backwards on the socket.

YawY.title: YawY
YawY.description: How far the attachment is turned around the socket.

RollZ.title: RollZ
RollZ.description: How far the attachment is rolled around its own forward axis.

Scale.title: Scale
Scale.description: The multiplier applied to the attachment on every axis, used when the per-axis scale fields are left at zero.

ScaleX.title: ScaleX
ScaleX.description: The multiplier applied to the attachment's width, which overrides the uniform scale when it is set.

ScaleY.title: ScaleY
ScaleY.description: The multiplier applied to the attachment's height, which overrides the uniform scale when it is set.

ScaleZ.title: ScaleZ
ScaleZ.description: The multiplier applied to the attachment's depth, which overrides the uniform scale when it is set.

NormalOffset.title: NormalOffset
NormalOffset.description: How far the attachment is lifted along the surface normal, so it does not sink into what it is held against.

ParentAttachmentId.title: ParentAttachmentId
ParentAttachmentId.description: The attachment this one hangs off, which lets a scope sit on a rifle rather than on the hand.

left_hand.title: left_hand
left_hand.description: The attachments carried in the model's left hand, one alternative per entry.

chest.title: chest
chest.description: The attachments worn on the model's chest, one alternative per entry.

root.title: root
root.description: The attachments carried at the model's root, which follow the unit without being held.

head.title: head
head.description: The attachments worn on the model's head, one alternative per entry.

left_foot.title: left_foot
left_foot.description: The attachments worn on the model's left foot.

right_foot.title: right_foot
right_foot.description: The attachments worn on the model's right foot.

ground.title: ground
ground.description: The attachments placed on the ground under the model, such as a banner planted on the spot.

center.title: center
center.description: The attachments placed at the model's centre of mass.

overhead.title: overhead
overhead.description: The attachments drawn above the model, such as a crest or a carried standard.

pivot.title: pivot
pivot.description: The attachments placed at the model's pivot, which is the point it turns around.

custom_sockets.title: custom_sockets
custom_sockets.description: The attachments carried on sockets the model or the map declares itself, keyed by the socket's name.

CustomSocketLists.title: CustomSocketLists
CustomSocketLists.description: The custom socket attachments read back as a dictionary, which is the same content as the custom sockets field and never written on its own.

Sounds.title: Sounds
Sounds.description: The voice lines and sound effects the unit plays in response to orders, wounds, death and spell casts.

VoiceAsset.title: VoiceAsset
VoiceAsset.description: The voice set the unit speaks with, which its individual lines are drawn from.

OnSelect.title: OnSelect
OnSelect.description: The lines played when the unit is selected.

OnMoveOrder.title: OnMoveOrder
OnMoveOrder.description: The lines played when the unit is ordered to move.

OnAttackOrder.title: OnAttackOrder
OnAttackOrder.description: The lines played when the unit is ordered to attack.

OnWounded.title: OnWounded
OnWounded.description: The lines played when the unit is wounded.

OnDeath.title: OnDeath
OnDeath.description: The lines played when the unit dies.

OnReady.title: OnReady
OnReady.description: The lines played when the unit finishes training and is ready.

OnSpellCast.title: OnSpellCast
OnSpellCast.description: The lines played when the unit casts a spell.

StartingItems.title: StartingItems
StartingItems.description: The items the unit is carrying when it is trained.

ShopItems.title: ShopItems
ShopItems.description: The items the unit offers for sale when it is selected.

Upgrades.title: Upgrades
Upgrades.description: The upgrades the unit offers for research when it is selected.

StatusEffects.title: StatusEffects
StatusEffects.description: Status effects the unit carries from the moment it is trained.

SoundEvents.title: SoundEvents
SoundEvents.description: The sound events the map's script raises on this unit, which its sound lists answer by name.

ConstructionRange.title: ConstructionRange
ConstructionRange.description: How close a worker has to stand to a site before it may start or continue building there.

TemplateID.title: TemplateID
TemplateID.description: The identifier every other template, order, build option and script uses to name this placeable.

Name.title: Name
Name.description: The name the placeable shows on its command card, in its tooltip and in the editor.

Description.title: Description
Description.description: The tooltip text explaining what the placeable is and what it is for.

ModelPath.title: ModelPath
ModelPath.description: Path to the model shown in the editor and on the battlefield.

PortraitModelPath.title: PortraitModelPath
PortraitModelPath.description: Path to the model shown in the portrait panel while this placeable is selected.

VisualMode.title: VisualMode
VisualMode.description: How the model is laid out in the world, such as standing on the ground plane or lying flat as a decal.

Scale.title: Scale
Scale.description: The multiplier applied to the model's authored size when it is drawn on the battlefield.

YOffset.title: YOffset
YOffset.description: How far the model is lifted above the ground, in metres, so a mesh authored around its base sits correctly.

CollisionCircle.title: CollisionCircle
CollisionCircle.description: The radius of the footprint the placeable blocks with, in metres. Zero lets other units walk through it.

Brightness.title: Brightness
Brightness.description: How strongly the model brightens the terrain colour underneath it, from no effect to fully lit.

Tint.title: Tint
Tint.description: The colour multiplied over the model's own colour, so one mesh can serve several teams.

NormalizeLuminance.title: NormalizeLuminance
NormalizeLuminance.description: Whether the model's overall brightness is normalised before it is tinted, so a dark skin and a light skin tint identically.

IgnorePlayerColor.title: IgnorePlayerColor
IgnorePlayerColor.description: Whether the player's colour is left out of the model entirely instead of being tinted over it.

DespillPlayerColor.title: DespillPlayerColor
DespillPlayerColor.description: Whether the player's colour is removed from the model's own pixels before team colour is applied, which stops a red skin tinting red twice.

PathingType.title: PathingType
PathingType.description: The pathing the placeable's footprint provides to units crossing it, declared as named bits.

SpawnShader.title: SpawnShader
SpawnShader.description: The spawn shader played where the placeable appears, such as the materialise effect a building site plays.

DeathShader.title: DeathShader
DeathShader.description: The shader played as the placeable dies or is removed.

ProceduralAnimation.title: ProceduralAnimation
ProceduralAnimation.description: The procedural motion profile that makes the model sway, flutter or shake, referenced by name.

EnableProceduralAnimation.title: EnableProceduralAnimation
EnableProceduralAnimation.description: Whether the procedural motion profile runs. Absent means it runs whenever one is named.

PseudoSockets.title: PseudoSockets
PseudoSockets.description: Anchors the map adds to the model, which attachments and visual effects can be parented to by name.

items.description: A named point on a placeable's model that attachments and visual effects can be parented to, for a mesh that has no real socket there.

SocketId.title: SocketId
SocketId.description: The name a unit's object attachment table names this point by.

Position.title: Position
Position.description: Where the point sits in the model's own space, in metres.

X.title: X
X.description: The distance along the first horizontal axis.

Y.title: Y
Y.description: The distance along the vertical axis.

Z.title: Z
Z.description: The distance along the second horizontal axis.

RotationDegrees.title: RotationDegrees
RotationDegrees.description: How the point is turned in the model's own space, in degrees around each axis.

X.title: X
X.description: The distance along the first horizontal axis.

Y.title: Y
Y.description: The distance along the vertical axis.

Z.title: Z
Z.description: The distance along the second horizontal axis.

DespawnShader.title: DespawnShader
DespawnShader.description: The shader played as the placeable is removed without dying, such as a building sold for its cost back.

Attribution_ImportedFromMap.title: Attribution_ImportedFromMap
Attribution_ImportedFromMap.description: The map the placeable was imported from, kept so attribution survives a round trip through the editor.

Buildings.title: Buildings
Buildings.description: The buildings a player raises, which are units that stay where they are put.

items.description: One unit or building template: its combat stats, its price, what it can build, cast and carry, and how it moves, dies and sounds.

Resources.title: Resources
Resources.description: The gatherable nodes workers harvest from, such as trees, gold veins and stone outcrops.

items.description: A gatherable node such as a tree, a gold vein or a stone outcrop: how much it holds, how fast workers empty it and how it grows back.

MaxCapacity.title: MaxCapacity
MaxCapacity.description: How much of its resource the node holds when a match starts, before any per-level bonus.

HarvestRate.title: HarvestRate
HarvestRate.description: How much a worker takes from the node per harvest swing.

GrowthRate.title: GrowthRate
GrowthRate.description: How much the node regrows per second while it is not being harvested. Zero means it never comes back.

MaxWorkers.title: MaxWorkers
MaxWorkers.description: How many workers may harvest this node at the same time.

Level.title: Level
Level.description: The level the node starts at, which its capacity and armour per level are multiplied by.

MaxCapacityPerLevel.title: MaxCapacityPerLevel
MaxCapacityPerLevel.description: How much capacity every level above the first adds to the node.

Armor.title: Armor
Armor.description: Flat damage reduction the node applies to every hit, so a weak worker takes longer to empty it.

ArmorPerLevel.title: ArmorPerLevel
ArmorPerLevel.description: How much armour every level above the first adds to the node.

MagicResistance.title: MagicResistance
MagicResistance.description: Flat reduction the node applies to magical damage.

MagicResistancePerLevel.title: MagicResistancePerLevel
MagicResistancePerLevel.description: How much magic resistance every level above the first adds to the node.

ResourceType.title: ResourceType
ResourceType.description: The kind of resource the node yields, such as gold, wood or stone.

ItemTemplateId.title: ItemTemplateId
ItemTemplateId.description: The item template one harvested piece of the node becomes when a worker carries it home.

YieldPerDamage.title: YieldPerDamage
YieldPerDamage.description: How many pieces of the node's item one point of damage after mitigation yields. One makes every point of a hit a piece; a smaller value makes the node give up its capacity more slowly than a hit can eat it.

Scale.title: Scale
Scale.description: The multiplier applied to the node's model size, so a tree canopy or a boulder sits at the size the map wants.

TemplateID.title: TemplateID
TemplateID.description: The identifier every other template, order, build option and script uses to name this placeable.

Name.title: Name
Name.description: The name the placeable shows on its command card, in its tooltip and in the editor.

Description.title: Description
Description.description: The tooltip text explaining what the placeable is and what it is for.

ModelPath.title: ModelPath
ModelPath.description: Path to the model shown in the editor and on the battlefield.

PortraitModelPath.title: PortraitModelPath
PortraitModelPath.description: Path to the model shown in the portrait panel while this placeable is selected.

VisualMode.title: VisualMode
VisualMode.description: How the model is laid out in the world, such as standing on the ground plane or lying flat as a decal.

YOffset.title: YOffset
YOffset.description: How far the model is lifted above the ground, in metres, so a mesh authored around its base sits correctly.

CollisionCircle.title: CollisionCircle
CollisionCircle.description: The radius of the footprint the placeable blocks with, in metres. Zero lets other units walk through it.

Brightness.title: Brightness
Brightness.description: How strongly the model brightens the terrain colour underneath it, from no effect to fully lit.

Tint.title: Tint
Tint.description: The colour multiplied over the model's own colour, so one mesh can serve several teams.

NormalizeLuminance.title: NormalizeLuminance
NormalizeLuminance.description: Whether the model's overall brightness is normalised before it is tinted, so a dark skin and a light skin tint identically.

IgnorePlayerColor.title: IgnorePlayerColor
IgnorePlayerColor.description: Whether the player's colour is left out of the model entirely instead of being tinted over it.

DespillPlayerColor.title: DespillPlayerColor
DespillPlayerColor.description: Whether the player's colour is removed from the model's own pixels before team colour is applied, which stops a red skin tinting red twice.

PathingType.title: PathingType
PathingType.description: The pathing the placeable's footprint provides to units crossing it, declared as named bits.

SpawnShader.title: SpawnShader
SpawnShader.description: The spawn shader played where the placeable appears, such as the materialise effect a building site plays.

DeathShader.title: DeathShader
DeathShader.description: The shader played as the placeable dies or is removed.

ProceduralAnimation.title: ProceduralAnimation
ProceduralAnimation.description: The procedural motion profile that makes the model sway, flutter or shake, referenced by name.

EnableProceduralAnimation.title: EnableProceduralAnimation
EnableProceduralAnimation.description: Whether the procedural motion profile runs. Absent means it runs whenever one is named.

PseudoSockets.title: PseudoSockets
PseudoSockets.description: Anchors the map adds to the model, which attachments and visual effects can be parented to by name.

items.description: A named point on a placeable's model that attachments and visual effects can be parented to, for a mesh that has no real socket there.

DespawnShader.title: DespawnShader
DespawnShader.description: The shader played as the placeable is removed without dying, such as a building sold for its cost back.

Attribution_ImportedFromMap.title: Attribution_ImportedFromMap
Attribution_ImportedFromMap.description: The map the placeable was imported from, kept so attribution survives a round trip through the editor.

Props.title: Props
Props.description: The decorative scenery a map places for looks or to block movement.

items.description: A decorative piece of scenery the map places for looks or to block movement, such as a rock, a fence or a ruin.

Scale.title: Scale
Scale.description: The multiplier applied to the prop's model size, which a rock cluster or a fence post uses to sit at the right height.

TemplateID.title: TemplateID
TemplateID.description: The identifier every other template, order, build option and script uses to name this placeable.

Name.title: Name
Name.description: The name the placeable shows on its command card, in its tooltip and in the editor.

Description.title: Description
Description.description: The tooltip text explaining what the placeable is and what it is for.

ModelPath.title: ModelPath
ModelPath.description: Path to the model shown in the editor and on the battlefield.

PortraitModelPath.title: PortraitModelPath
PortraitModelPath.description: Path to the model shown in the portrait panel while this placeable is selected.

VisualMode.title: VisualMode
VisualMode.description: How the model is laid out in the world, such as standing on the ground plane or lying flat as a decal.

YOffset.title: YOffset
YOffset.description: How far the model is lifted above the ground, in metres, so a mesh authored around its base sits correctly.

CollisionCircle.title: CollisionCircle
CollisionCircle.description: The radius of the footprint the placeable blocks with, in metres. Zero lets other units walk through it.

Brightness.title: Brightness
Brightness.description: How strongly the model brightens the terrain colour underneath it, from no effect to fully lit.

Tint.title: Tint
Tint.description: The colour multiplied over the model's own colour, so one mesh can serve several teams.

NormalizeLuminance.title: NormalizeLuminance
NormalizeLuminance.description: Whether the model's overall brightness is normalised before it is tinted, so a dark skin and a light skin tint identically.

IgnorePlayerColor.title: IgnorePlayerColor
IgnorePlayerColor.description: Whether the player's colour is left out of the model entirely instead of being tinted over it.

DespillPlayerColor.title: DespillPlayerColor
DespillPlayerColor.description: Whether the player's colour is removed from the model's own pixels before team colour is applied, which stops a red skin tinting red twice.

PathingType.title: PathingType
PathingType.description: The pathing the placeable's footprint provides to units crossing it, declared as named bits.

SpawnShader.title: SpawnShader
SpawnShader.description: The spawn shader played where the placeable appears, such as the materialise effect a building site plays.

DeathShader.title: DeathShader
DeathShader.description: The shader played as the placeable dies or is removed.

ProceduralAnimation.title: ProceduralAnimation
ProceduralAnimation.description: The procedural motion profile that makes the model sway, flutter or shake, referenced by name.

EnableProceduralAnimation.title: EnableProceduralAnimation
EnableProceduralAnimation.description: Whether the procedural motion profile runs. Absent means it runs whenever one is named.

PseudoSockets.title: PseudoSockets
PseudoSockets.description: Anchors the map adds to the model, which attachments and visual effects can be parented to by name.

items.description: A named point on a placeable's model that attachments and visual effects can be parented to, for a mesh that has no real socket there.

DespawnShader.title: DespawnShader
DespawnShader.description: The shader played as the placeable is removed without dying, such as a building sold for its cost back.

Attribution_ImportedFromMap.title: Attribution_ImportedFromMap
Attribution_ImportedFromMap.description: The map the placeable was imported from, kept so attribution survives a round trip through the editor.

Abilities.title: Abilities
Abilities.description: The abilities units cast from their command cards.

items.description: One ability a unit casts from its command card: what it costs, how far it reaches, what it summons or spawns, and what it does to the units it lands on.

TemplateID.title: TemplateID
TemplateID.description: The identifier command cards, items and scripts use to name this ability.

Name.title: Name
Name.description: The name the ability shows on its command card.

Description.title: Description
Description.description: The tooltip text explaining what the ability does and how much it costs.

Role.title: Role
Role.description: How the ability is grouped when the command card decides what a hero's spells are for, such as damage, control or support.

AbilityType.title: AbilityType
AbilityType.description: How the ability is aimed, such as at a point, at a unit or at no target at all.

IconPath.title: IconPath
IconPath.description: Path to the icon shown for the ability on its command card.

ManaCost.title: ManaCost
ManaCost.description: Mana the caster spends to cast the ability.

CostGold.title: CostGold
CostGold.description: Gold the caster spends to cast the ability, for a script-defined spell that charges resources of its own.

CostWood.title: CostWood
CostWood.description: Wood the caster spends to cast the ability, for a script-defined spell that charges resources of its own.

CostStone.title: CostStone
CostStone.description: Stone the caster spends to cast the ability, for a script-defined spell that charges resources of its own.

Cooldown.title: Cooldown
Cooldown.description: How long the ability has to wait after a cast before it may be cast again.

TargetRange.title: TargetRange
TargetRange.description: How far from the caster the ability may be aimed.

VisualEffect.title: VisualEffect
VisualEffect.description: The visual effect played where the ability is cast.

ProjectileId.title: ProjectileId
ProjectileId.description: A weapon template the ability fires as its own visual, flown from the caster to the point it was cast at and reported back through onSpellImpact as an impact.

CastSound.title: CastSound
CastSound.description: The sound played when the ability is cast.

PlacementTemplateId.title: PlacementTemplateId
PlacementTemplateId.description: The template this card places on the board instead of casting at a point, using the standard construction placement that follows the cursor.

AutoCast.title: AutoCast
AutoCast.description: The conditions under which a unit casts the ability on its own, without being ordered to.

Enabled.title: Enabled
Enabled.description: Whether the unit casts the ability on its own at all.

TargetRule.title: TargetRule
TargetRule.description: Who the unit picks when it casts on its own.
enumDescriptions: The caster itself, for a spell that buffs or heals the unit that cast it.
The closest enemy the caster can reach with the ability.
The friendly unit that has lost the largest share of its health.
The friendly unit with the least health left in absolute terms.
A friendly unit that does not already carry the effect the ability applies.

AllyHealthPercentBelow.title: AllyHealthPercentBelow
AllyHealthPercentBelow.description: How wounded a friendly unit has to be before a healing auto cast picks it, as a fraction of its maximum health.

ManaReserve.title: ManaReserve
ManaReserve.description: How much mana the unit keeps in reserve, and therefore never spends on auto cast.

MinManaPercent.title: MinManaPercent
MinManaPercent.description: The share of the unit's maximum mana below which it stops casting on its own, as a fraction of one.

AreaOfEffectRadius.title: AreaOfEffectRadius
AreaOfEffectRadius.description: The radius around the point the ability is aimed at inside which it lands.

Effects.title: Effects
Effects.description: What the ability does, effect by effect: damage, healing, buffs, summons and their target shapes.

items.description: One thing an ability does when it lands: how much damage or healing it applies, in what shape, to which side, and what it summons or charges for it.

Kind.title: Kind
Kind.description: What the effect does, such as damage, heal, buff, summon or displace.

Delivery.title: Delivery
Delivery.description: How the effect reaches its targets, such as instantly at the aim point or in a travelling wave.

Targets.title: Targets
Targets.description: Which side of the fight the effect lands on, such as enemies, allies or the caster itself.

Radius.title: Radius
Radius.description: How far from the aim point the effect reaches.

Length.title: Length
Length.description: How long the effect's shape is when it is a line rather than a circle.

AngleDegrees.title: AngleDegrees
AngleDegrees.description: How wide the effect's cone opens when it is a cone rather than a circle.

MaxTargets.title: MaxTargets
MaxTargets.description: How many units the effect may land on at once. Zero means as many as the shape covers.

Amount.title: Amount
Amount.description: How much the effect applies: damage, healing or the base value its scaling starts from.

Duration.title: Duration
Duration.description: How long what the effect applies lasts, such as a buff's length or a summon's lifetime.

DamageType.title: DamageType
DamageType.description: Whether the effect's damage is mitigated as physical or as magical.

BuffId.title: BuffId
BuffId.description: The status effect the ability applies to the units it lands on.

Modifiers.title: Modifiers
Modifiers.description: The stat changes the ability applies for as long as its effect lasts.

items.description: One change an upgrade, item or ability makes to a unit's stats, applied flat, as a percentage or through a script function.

StatKey.title: StatKey
StatKey.description: The stat the modifier changes, named the way the engine's stat table names it.

Type.title: Type
Type.description: How the value is applied: added flat, added as a percentage of the base, or set outright.

Value.title: Value
Value.description: How much the modifier changes the stat by.

WASMFunctionName.title: WASMFunctionName
WASMFunctionName.description: The map script function that computes the modifier's value instead of a fixed number, called once per affected unit.

PerLevelScaling.title: PerLevelScaling
PerLevelScaling.description: How much the modifier grows for every level the upgrade has been researched.

SummonUnitId.title: SummonUnitId
SummonUnitId.description: The unit template the ability places on the battlefield.

SummonCount.title: SummonCount
SummonCount.description: How many units one cast of the summoning ability places.

SummonCap.title: SummonCap
SummonCap.description: How many of the summoned units one caster may have alive at once. Zero means no limit.

Scaling.title: Scaling
Scaling.description: How the effect's amount grows with one of the caster's attributes.

Attribute.title: Attribute
Attribute.description: The caster attribute the effect scales with.

Shape.title: Shape
Shape.description: How the attribute is turned into extra effect, such as a straight line or a diminishing curve.

Coefficient.title: Coefficient
Coefficient.description: How much extra effect each point of the attribute is worth.

Divisor.title: Divisor
Divisor.description: What the scaled bonus is divided by, which softens a large coefficient into a readable number.

Cap.title: Cap
Cap.description: The most the attribute may add to the effect. Zero means the bonus is uncapped.

Offset.title: Offset
Offset.description: A flat amount added to the scaled bonus before it is applied.

ScalesDuration.title: ScalesDuration
ScalesDuration.description: Whether the attribute also stretches the effect's duration, not just its amount.

GridX.title: GridX
GridX.description: The column of the command card the ability occupies, counted from the left. Minus one lets the card place it.

GridY.title: GridY
GridY.description: The row of the command card the ability occupies, counted from the top. Minus one lets the card place it.

Hotkey.title: Hotkey
Hotkey.description: The keyboard key that casts the ability, as one character.

Attribution_ImportedFromMap.title: Attribution_ImportedFromMap
Attribution_ImportedFromMap.description: The map the ability was imported from, kept so attribution survives a round trip through the editor.

Weapons.title: Weapons
Weapons.description: The weapons units attack with, including the projectiles they fly.

items.description: One weapon a unit attacks with, and the projectile it flies: its damage, its reach, its flight path, the effect that trails it and how it looks when it lands.

TemplateID.title: TemplateID
TemplateID.description: The identifier unit templates name this weapon by.

Name.title: Name
Name.description: The name the weapon shows when its damage is broken down for a player.

Damage.title: Damage
Damage.description: Damage one attack with this weapon deals before mitigation.

Range.title: Range
Range.description: How far this weapon reaches, measured from the attacker's edge to the target's edge.

AttackCooldown.title: AttackCooldown
AttackCooldown.description: How long the attacker waits between attacks with this weapon.

AttackType.title: AttackType
AttackType.description: Whether the weapon strikes immediately or flies something at the target.

DamageType.title: DamageType
DamageType.description: Whether the weapon's damage is mitigated as physical or as magical.

ProjectileSpeed.title: ProjectileSpeed
ProjectileSpeed.description: How fast the projectile travels. Zero hits its target immediately.

VisualEffect.title: VisualEffect
VisualEffect.description: The visual effect attached to the projectile or the swing.

AttackSound.title: AttackSound
AttackSound.description: The sound played when the weapon attacks.

ProjectileModelPath.title: ProjectileModelPath
ProjectileModelPath.description: Path to the model the projectile flies, and the model a summoned projectile shows in the editor.

ImpactVisualEffect.title: ImpactVisualEffect
ImpactVisualEffect.description: The visual effect played where the projectile lands.

ImpactParticleEffect.title: ImpactParticleEffect
ImpactParticleEffect.description: The sprite sheet effect sprayed where the projectile lands.

ImpactParticleScale.title: ImpactParticleScale
ImpactParticleScale.description: The multiplier applied to the landing effect's size.

ImpactSound.title: ImpactSound
ImpactSound.description: The sound played where the projectile lands.

TrajectoryType.title: TrajectoryType
TrajectoryType.description: The path the projectile follows, such as a straight line, an arc, a boomerang or an orbit.

BoomerangReturnDelay.title: BoomerangReturnDelay
BoomerangReturnDelay.description: How long a boomerang projectile waits at its furthest point before it flies back.

OrbitRadius.title: OrbitRadius
OrbitRadius.description: How far from the attacker an orbiting projectile circles.

OrbitSpeed.title: OrbitSpeed
OrbitSpeed.description: How fast an orbiting projectile circles its owner.

ArcHeight.title: ArcHeight
ArcHeight.description: How high an arcing projectile rises above the straight line between attacker and target.

HomingWeight.title: HomingWeight
HomingWeight.description: How strongly a homing projectile steers after a target that moves. Zero flies the path it started on.

TurnRateLimit.title: TurnRateLimit
TurnRateLimit.description: How sharply a homing projectile may turn.

EaseCurve.title: EaseCurve
EaseCurve.description: The curve the projectile's progress along its path is eased with.

SpeedCurve.title: SpeedCurve
SpeedCurve.description: The curve the projectile's speed is shaped with over its flight.

Acceleration.title: Acceleration
Acceleration.description: How quickly the projectile gains speed along its path.

MaxLifetime.title: MaxLifetime
MaxLifetime.description: How long the projectile lives before it gives up and disappears.

FailsafeRange.title: FailsafeRange
FailsafeRange.description: How far the projectile may travel before it gives up, which bounds a shot at a target that keeps running.

ScaleCurve.title: ScaleCurve
ScaleCurve.description: The curve the projectile's size is shaped with over its flight.

TumbleAngularVelocity.title: TumbleAngularVelocity
TumbleAngularVelocity.description: How fast the projectile tumbles while it flies, as degrees per second around each axis.

X.title: X
X.description: The distance along the first horizontal axis.

Y.title: Y
Y.description: The distance along the vertical axis.

Z.title: Z
Z.description: The distance along the second horizontal axis.

OrientToTrajectory.title: OrientToTrajectory
OrientToTrajectory.description: Whether the projectile model is turned to face the direction it is travelling.

ForwardAxisPreset.title: ForwardAxisPreset
ForwardAxisPreset.description: Which of the model's own axes points forward, so a authored mesh flies nose first.

MeshRotationOffset.title: MeshRotationOffset
MeshRotationOffset.description: A rotation added to the projectile model on top of the direction it is travelling.

X.title: X
X.description: The distance along the first horizontal axis.

Y.title: Y
Y.description: The distance along the vertical axis.

Z.title: Z
Z.description: The distance along the second horizontal axis.

MeshTranslationOffset.title: MeshTranslationOffset
MeshTranslationOffset.description: A translation added to the projectile model, which centres a mesh authored around another origin.

X.title: X
X.description: The distance along the first horizontal axis.

Y.title: Y
Y.description: The distance along the vertical axis.

Z.title: Z
Z.description: The distance along the second horizontal axis.

MeshScaleOffset.title: MeshScaleOffset
MeshScaleOffset.description: A size multiplier applied to the projectile model.

X.title: X
X.description: The distance along the first horizontal axis.

Y.title: Y
Y.description: The distance along the vertical axis.

Z.title: Z
Z.description: The distance along the second horizontal axis.

SpiralRadius.title: SpiralRadius
SpiralRadius.description: How far a spiralling projectile swings away from its path.

SpiralFrequency.title: SpiralFrequency
SpiralFrequency.description: How many times a spiralling projectile winds around its path over the flight.

ZigzagAmplitude.title: ZigzagAmplitude
ZigzagAmplitude.description: How far a zigzagging projectile swings away from its path.

ZigzagFrequency.title: ZigzagFrequency
ZigzagFrequency.description: How many times a zigzagging projectile crosses its path over the flight.

MaxBounces.title: MaxBounces
MaxBounces.description: How many times the projectile may bounce off a unit or the ground before it is spent.

PierceCount.title: PierceCount
PierceCount.description: How many further units the projectile passes through after its first hit.

ShaderEffectType.title: ShaderEffectType
ShaderEffectType.description: The shader the projectile is drawn with, such as a trail of noise or a pulsing glow.

EmissionMaskSource.title: EmissionMaskSource
EmissionMaskSource.description: Which channel of the projectile's material drives its emission, such as the noise texture or the base colour.

BaseColor.title: BaseColor
BaseColor.description: The base colour the projectile's material starts from.

EmissionColor.title: EmissionColor
EmissionColor.description: The colour the projectile's emission glows with.

EmissionEnergy.title: EmissionEnergy
EmissionEnergy.description: How strongly the projectile's emission glows.

FresnelPower.title: FresnelPower
FresnelPower.description: How tightly the projectile's rim glow hugs its silhouette. Higher values keep the glow at the edges.

FresnelColor.title: FresnelColor
FresnelColor.description: The colour of the projectile's rim glow.

FresnelFactor.title: FresnelFactor
FresnelFactor.description: How strong the projectile's rim glow is.

NoiseScale.title: NoiseScale
NoiseScale.description: The size of the noise pattern the projectile's material samples.

NoiseTexture.title: NoiseTexture
NoiseTexture.description: The noise texture the projectile's material samples.

UvScrollSpeed1.title: UvScrollSpeed1
UvScrollSpeed1.description: How fast the projectile's first uv layer scrolls, which animates its surface without a sprite sheet.

X.title: X
X.description: The value along the first axis.

Y.title: Y
Y.description: The value along the second axis.

UvScrollSpeed2.title: UvScrollSpeed2
UvScrollSpeed2.description: How fast the projectile's second uv layer scrolls, which the shader blends with the first.

X.title: X
X.description: The value along the first axis.

Y.title: Y
Y.description: The value along the second axis.

ThresholdCutoff.title: ThresholdCutoff
ThresholdCutoff.description: The noise value below which the projectile's material is cut away entirely.

ThresholdSmoothness.title: ThresholdSmoothness
ThresholdSmoothness.description: How soft the edge of the cutoff is, so the projectile dissolves instead of ending in hard pixels.

PointLightEnabled.title: PointLightEnabled
PointLightEnabled.description: Whether the projectile carries a light that lights the ground it passes over.

PointLightColor.title: PointLightColor
PointLightColor.description: The colour of the light the projectile carries.

PointLightIntensity.title: PointLightIntensity
PointLightIntensity.description: How strongly the projectile's light lights its surroundings.

PointLightRange.title: PointLightRange
PointLightRange.description: How far the projectile's light reaches.

RibbonTexture.title: RibbonTexture
RibbonTexture.description: The ribbon texture dragged behind the projectile.

RibbonColor.title: RibbonColor
RibbonColor.description: The colour multiplied over the projectile's ribbon.

RibbonWidth.title: RibbonWidth
RibbonWidth.description: How wide the projectile's ribbon is where it leaves the projectile.

RibbonLifetime.title: RibbonLifetime
RibbonLifetime.description: How long a piece of the projectile's ribbon lives before it fades.

RibbonTaper.title: RibbonTaper
RibbonTaper.description: Whether the projectile's ribbon narrows to a point at its tail.

RibbonAdditive.title: RibbonAdditive
RibbonAdditive.description: Whether the projectile's ribbon adds its colour to what is behind it instead of blending over it.

RibbonScrollSpeed.title: RibbonScrollSpeed
RibbonScrollSpeed.description: How fast the projectile's ribbon texture scrolls along the trail.

TrailOffset.title: TrailOffset
TrailOffset.description: Where the ribbon leaves the projectile's model, relative to the projectile's own origin.

X.title: X
X.description: The distance along the first horizontal axis.

Y.title: Y
Y.description: The distance along the vertical axis.

Z.title: Z
Z.description: The distance along the second horizontal axis.

Attribution_ImportedFromMap.title: Attribution_ImportedFromMap
Attribution_ImportedFromMap.description: The map the weapon was imported from, kept so attribution survives a round trip through the editor.

Upgrades.title: Upgrades
Upgrades.description: The upgrades a player researches to change their army.

items.description: One researchable upgrade: what it costs, how long it takes, which units it applies to and what it changes about them.

TemplateID.title: TemplateID
TemplateID.description: The identifier unit templates and requirement expressions name this upgrade by.

Name.title: Name
Name.description: The name the upgrade shows on its command card.

Description.title: Description
Description.description: The tooltip text explaining what the upgrade changes and what it costs.

IconPath.title: IconPath
IconPath.description: Path to the icon shown for the upgrade on its command card.

Hotkey.title: Hotkey
Hotkey.description: The keyboard key that starts researching the upgrade, as one character.

CostGold.title: CostGold
CostGold.description: Gold the upgrade costs to research.

CostWood.title: CostWood
CostWood.description: Wood the upgrade costs to research.

CostStone.title: CostStone
CostStone.description: Stone the upgrade costs to research.

ResearchTime.title: ResearchTime
ResearchTime.description: How long the researching building takes to finish the upgrade.

Requirement.title: Requirement
Requirement.description: The requirement expression that has to hold before the upgrade may be researched.

MaxLevel.title: MaxLevel
MaxLevel.description: How many times the upgrade may be researched, each level stacking its modifiers again.

AffectedUnitIds.title: AffectedUnitIds
AffectedUnitIds.description: The unit templates the upgrade applies to. Absent or empty means the player's whole army, now and for units fielded later; a single star says the same thing explicitly.

Modifiers.title: Modifiers
Modifiers.description: What the upgrade changes about the units it applies to, one stat at a time.

items.description: One change an upgrade, item or ability makes to a unit's stats, applied flat, as a percentage or through a script function.

Attribution_ImportedFromMap.title: Attribution_ImportedFromMap
Attribution_ImportedFromMap.description: The map the upgrade was imported from, kept so attribution survives a round trip through the editor.

Items.title: Items
Items.description: The items units carry and shops sell.

items.description: One item a unit can carry or buy: a consumable, a relic, a piece of equipment or a container. Its card, its price, what it grants and where it may be used live here.

TemplateID.title: TemplateID
TemplateID.description: The identifier every other template, shop entry and script uses to name this item.

Name.title: Name
Name.description: The name the item shows on its command card and in its tooltip.

Description.title: Description
Description.description: The tooltip text explaining what the item does when a player hovers over it.

ItemClass.title: ItemClass
ItemClass.description: The class the item belongs to, which decides how shops group it and how many a unit may hold at once.

CostGold.title: CostGold
CostGold.description: Gold a player pays for the item. Zero makes it free.

CostWood.title: CostWood
CostWood.description: Wood a player pays for the item. Zero makes it cost no wood.

CostStone.title: CostStone
CostStone.description: Stone a player pays for the item. Zero makes it cost no stone.

TargetScope.title: TargetScope
TargetScope.description: Which units the item may be used on, such as the carrier alone or any friendly unit.

SlotGroup.title: SlotGroup
SlotGroup.description: The slot group the item occupies, so two items of the same group cannot be carried at the same time.

MaxPerUnit.title: MaxPerUnit
MaxPerUnit.description: How many of the item one unit may carry at once.

ClearsSlot.title: ClearsSlot
ClearsSlot.description: Whether using the item empties the slot it sat in, which is what a consumable does and a relic does not.

PurchaseRange.title: PurchaseRange
PurchaseRange.description: How close the buying unit has to be to a shop before it may purchase the item.

UseAbility.title: UseAbility
UseAbility.description: The ability the item casts when it is used.

AbilityId.title: AbilityId
AbilityId.description: The ability whose card, cooldown and effects the item presents, when the item is the face of an ability rather than a cast of its own.

CardId.title: CardId
CardId.description: The name the item's card is keyed by, which is its ability when it has one and its own identifier otherwise.

ChargeCount.title: ChargeCount
ChargeCount.description: How many charges the item arrives with. A charge is spent on use and the item is gone when the last one is.

MaxStacks.title: MaxStacks
MaxStacks.description: How many times the item may be bought and stacked on one unit before the shop refuses further copies.

ResourceType.title: ResourceType
ResourceType.description: The resource the item stands for when it is a gathered piece rather than equipment, such as gold or wood.

CooldownLink.title: CooldownLink
CooldownLink.description: An ability whose cooldown this item shares, so using one puts both on cooldown.

CanDrop.title: CanDrop
CanDrop.description: Whether a unit may drop the item on the ground for another unit to pick up.

ItemLevel.title: ItemLevel
ItemLevel.description: The level the item counts as, which decides which shops stock it and which prerequisites accept it.

IconPath.title: IconPath
IconPath.description: Path to the icon shown for the item on its command card.

ModelPath.title: ModelPath
ModelPath.description: Path to the model shown for the item both as it lies on the ground and as a command card preview.

PassiveStatusEffects.title: PassiveStatusEffects
PassiveStatusEffects.description: Status effects the carrier keeps for as long as it holds the item.

GrantedWeapons.title: GrantedWeapons
GrantedWeapons.description: Weapons holding the item adds to the carrier's attack.

GrantedAbilities.title: GrantedAbilities
GrantedAbilities.description: Abilities holding the item adds to the carrier's command card.

GrantedUpgrades.title: GrantedUpgrades
GrantedUpgrades.description: Upgrades holding the item applies to its owner for as long as it is carried.

IsContainer.title: IsContainer
IsContainer.description: Whether the item is a container that holds other items instead of being used up itself.

ContainerSize.title: ContainerSize
ContainerSize.description: How many items a container item can hold at once.

Requirements.title: Requirements
Requirements.description: The requirement expression that has to hold before a unit may buy or carry the item.

Attribution_ImportedFromMap.title: Attribution_ImportedFromMap
Attribution_ImportedFromMap.description: The map the item was imported from, kept so attribution survives a round trip through the editor.

Consumables.title: Consumables
Consumables.description: The consumable items that are used up, kept apart from carried equipment so a shop can list them separately.

items.description: One item a unit can carry or buy: a consumable, a relic, a piece of equipment or a container. Its card, its price, what it grants and where it may be used live here.

Attachments.title: Attachments
Attachments.description: The models units carry in their hands or on named sockets.

items.description: A model a unit carries on a hand or a named socket, such as a sword, a shield or a banner, together with the effect that hangs off it.

AttachmentId.title: AttachmentId
AttachmentId.description: The identifier a unit's object attachment table names this attachment by.

Name.title: Name
Name.description: The name the attachment shows when a player inspects what a unit is carrying.

ModelPath.title: ModelPath
ModelPath.description: Path to the model drawn in the unit's hand or on its socket.

Scale.title: Scale
