MaskInvert.description: Whether the mask is inverted, so the parts that would stay still are the parts that move.

MaskRegionMin.title: MaskRegionMin
MaskRegionMin.description: The lower corner of the box only the inside of which moves, when the mask mode is a region box.

X.title: X
X.description: The distance along the first horizontal axis.

Y.title: Y
Y.description: The distance along the vertical axis.

Z.title: Z
Z.description: The distance along the second horizontal axis.

MaskRegionMax.title: MaskRegionMax
MaskRegionMax.description: The upper corner of the box only the inside of which moves, when the mask mode is a region box.

X.title: X
X.description: The distance along the first horizontal axis.

Y.title: Y
Y.description: The distance along the vertical axis.

Z.title: Z
Z.description: The distance along the second horizontal axis.

SwayRegions.title: SwayRegions
SwayRegions.description: The named regions of the model that sway with their own falloff instead of the profile's mask.

items.description: One named region of a model that sways on its own, such as a single banner or one branch, with its own falloff and mask.

ModelKey.title: ModelKey
ModelKey.description: The model the region belongs to, which lets one profile hold regions for several models.

RegionName.title: RegionName
RegionName.description: The name the model's own region declarations are matched against.

NormalizedMin.title: NormalizedMin
NormalizedMin.description: The lower corner of the region, in the model's normalised space where zero is the model's low extreme and one is its high extreme.

X.title: X
X.description: The distance along the first horizontal axis.

Y.title: Y
Y.description: The distance along the vertical axis.

Z.title: Z
Z.description: The distance along the second horizontal axis.

NormalizedMax.title: NormalizedMax
NormalizedMax.description: The upper corner of the region, in the model's normalised space where zero is the model's low extreme and one is its high extreme.

X.title: X
X.description: The distance along the first horizontal axis.

Y.title: Y
Y.description: The distance along the vertical axis.

Z.title: Z
Z.description: The distance along the second horizontal axis.

Feather.title: Feather
Feather.description: How softly the region's edge is blended, so motion fades out instead of stopping at a seam.

MaskPower.title: MaskPower
MaskPower.description: How sharply the region's mask falls off from its centre to its edge.

MaskInvert.title: MaskInvert
MaskInvert.description: Whether the region's mask is inverted, so everything outside the region sways instead of everything inside it.

SwayFrequency.title: SwayFrequency
SwayFrequency.description: How many times per second the model sways back and forth.

SwayAmplitude.title: SwayAmplitude
SwayAmplitude.description: How far the model sways from its rest pose.

FlutterFrequency.title: FlutterFrequency
FlutterFrequency.description: How many times per second the model flutters in the wind, which is the fine motion on top of the sway.

FlutterAmplitude.title: FlutterAmplitude
FlutterAmplitude.description: How far the model flutters from its rest pose.

WindInfluence.title: WindInfluence
WindInfluence.description: How strongly the match's wind pushes the model around.

VelocityDragInfluence.title: VelocityDragInfluence
VelocityDragInfluence.description: How strongly the model lags behind its own movement, which is what makes a banner trail a running unit.

WaveTurbulence.title: WaveTurbulence
WaveTurbulence.description: How irregular the wind's motion is, from a steady sway to a choppy one.

ImpulseDecay.title: ImpulseDecay
ImpulseDecay.description: How quickly the shake from a hit dies away.

ImpulseFrequency.title: ImpulseFrequency
ImpulseFrequency.description: How fast the model shakes when it is struck.

ImpulseAmplitude.title: ImpulseAmplitude
ImpulseAmplitude.description: How far the model moves when it is struck.

ImpulseDuration.title: ImpulseDuration
ImpulseDuration.description: How long the shake from a hit lasts.

CustomWaterProfiles.title: CustomWaterProfiles
CustomWaterProfiles.description: Water profiles the map adds to the engine's built-in ones, referenced by name from a texture's pathing profile.

items.description: One water profile: the colours, depth, waves, flow, refraction, glow and detail texture of water painted onto the terrain, and the pathing and bombing rules it carries.

Id.title: Id
Id.description: The identifier a texture's pathing profile names this water by.

Name.title: Name
Name.description: The name the water profile shows in the editor.

ProfileIndex.title: ProfileIndex
ProfileIndex.description: The numbered slot the water is painted with in the terrain editor.

ShallowColorHex.title: ShallowColorHex
ShallowColorHex.description: The colour of water where it is shallow enough to see the ground through it.

DeepColorHex.title: DeepColorHex
DeepColorHex.description: The colour of water where it is too deep to see the ground through it.

FoamColorHex.title: FoamColorHex
FoamColorHex.description: The colour of the foam along the shoreline.

MaxDepth.title: MaxDepth
MaxDepth.description: How deep the water has to be before it is fully drawn in its deep colour.

FoamDepth.title: FoamDepth
FoamDepth.description: How deep the water has to be for the shoreline foam to have faded away.

WaveSpeed.title: WaveSpeed
WaveSpeed.description: How fast the water's waves travel over its surface.

WaveStrength.title: WaveStrength
WaveStrength.description: How far the water's waves push its surface up and down.

UseNormalTexture.title: UseNormalTexture
UseNormalTexture.description: Whether the water is rippled with a normal map rather than by its wave function alone.

NormalTexturePath.title: NormalTexturePath
NormalTexturePath.description: Path to the normal map that ripples the water's surface.

NormalScale.title: NormalScale
NormalScale.description: How strongly the water's normal map bends the light.

FlowDirectionX.title: FlowDirectionX
FlowDirectionX.description: Which way the water flows along its surface, on the map's first horizontal axis.

FlowDirectionY.title: FlowDirectionY
FlowDirectionY.description: Which way the water flows along its surface, on the map's second horizontal axis.

FlowSpeed.title: FlowSpeed
FlowSpeed.description: How fast the water's surface drifts along its flow direction.

UseFlowMap.title: UseFlowMap
UseFlowMap.description: Whether the water's flow follows a painted flow map instead of one direction for the whole body of water.

FlowMapPath.title: FlowMapPath
FlowMapPath.description: Path to the flow map that steers the water's surface.

RefractionStrength.title: RefractionStrength
RefractionStrength.description: How strongly the water bends what is seen through it.

CausticStrength.title: CausticStrength
CausticStrength.description: How strongly the moving light patterns on the bottom of shallow water are drawn.

CausticScale.title: CausticScale
CausticScale.description: How large the caustic light patterns on the bottom are.

CausticSpeed.title: CausticSpeed
CausticSpeed.description: How fast the caustic light patterns on the bottom move.

EmissionColorHex.title: EmissionColorHex
EmissionColorHex.description: The colour the water glows with, for a magical or volcanic pool.

EmissionBoost.title: EmissionBoost
EmissionBoost.description: How strongly the water glows in its emission colour.

CoreColorHex.title: CoreColorHex
CoreColorHex.description: The colour of the brightest part of the water's glow.

CoreThreshold.title: CoreThreshold
CoreThreshold.description: The value above which the water is drawn in its core glow colour.

SubsurfaceColorHex.title: SubsurfaceColorHex
SubsurfaceColorHex.description: The colour light takes on after passing through the water, which is what gives a tropical sea its turquoise shallows.

SubsurfaceStrength.title: SubsurfaceStrength
SubsurfaceStrength.description: How strongly light takes on the subsurface colour as it passes through the water.

UseDetailTexture.title: UseDetailTexture
UseDetailTexture.description: Whether a detail texture is blended over the water's surface.

DetailTexturePath.title: DetailTexturePath
DetailTexturePath.description: Path to the detail texture blended over the water's surface.

DetailTileMode.title: DetailTileMode
DetailTileMode.description: How the detail texture is tiled over the water, such as a stochastic pattern that hides repetition.

DetailUvScaleX.title: DetailUvScaleX
DetailUvScaleX.description: How many times the detail texture repeats across the water.

DetailUvScaleY.title: DetailUvScaleY
DetailUvScaleY.description: How many times the detail texture repeats along the water.

DetailUvScrollX.title: DetailUvScrollX
DetailUvScrollX.description: How fast the detail texture drifts across the water.

DetailUvScrollY.title: DetailUvScrollY
DetailUvScrollY.description: How fast the detail texture drifts along the water.

DetailStochasticTileSize.title: DetailStochasticTileSize
DetailStochasticTileSize.description: The size of one stochastic tile of the detail texture.

DetailCrossFade.title: DetailCrossFade
DetailCrossFade.description: How softly two stochastic detail tiles blend where they meet.

DetailAlpha.title: DetailAlpha
DetailAlpha.description: How strongly the detail texture shows through the water's own colour.

DetailBlendMode.title: DetailBlendMode
DetailBlendMode.description: How the detail texture is blended with the water, such as multiplied, added or mixed.

DefaultPathingCode.title: DefaultPathingCode
DefaultPathingCode.description: The pathing the water provides to units crossing it, declared as named bits.

DecalBombingRules.title: DecalBombingRules
DecalBombingRules.description: The decals scattered over water painted with this profile, such as foam flecks.

items.description: One rule that scatters decals of a given template over ground painted with a swatch, with the spread of size, angle and tint each one is given.

DecalId.title: DecalId
DecalId.description: The decal template scattered by the rule.

Density.title: Density
Density.description: How densely the decals are scattered over the ground, as a share of the available spots.

MinScale.title: MinScale
MinScale.description: The smallest size a scattered decal is placed at.

MaxScale.title: MaxScale
MaxScale.description: The largest size a scattered decal is placed at.

MinRotationDeg.title: MinRotationDeg
MinRotationDeg.description: The smallest angle a scattered decal is turned to.

MaxRotationDeg.title: MaxRotationDeg
MaxRotationDeg.description: The largest angle a scattered decal is turned to.

TintHex.title: TintHex
TintHex.description: The colour multiplied over every scattered decal, which lets one template serve several grounds.

VfxBombingRules.title: VfxBombingRules
VfxBombingRules.description: The visual effects scattered over water painted with this profile, such as drifting mist.

items.description: One rule that scatters visual effects of a given template over ground painted with a swatch, with the spread of size and the distance each is lifted from the ground.

VfxId.title: VfxId
VfxId.description: The visual effect scattered by the rule.

Density.title: Density
Density.description: How densely the effects are scattered over the ground, as a share of the available spots.

MinScale.title: MinScale
MinScale.description: The smallest size a scattered effect is placed at.

MaxScale.title: MaxScale
MaxScale.description: The largest size a scattered effect is placed at.

NormalOffset.title: NormalOffset
NormalOffset.description: How far each effect is lifted along the ground's normal, so it does not sink into the surface.

Config.title: Config
Config.description: The configuration each scattered effect is spawned with, when it should differ from the template it names.

VfxId.title: VfxId
VfxId.description: The identifier abilities, weapons and attachments name this visual effect by.

Name.title: Name
Name.description: The name the visual effect shows in the editor.

PrimitiveType.title: PrimitiveType
PrimitiveType.description: The shape the effect is drawn with, which decides how its texture is wrapped and how it moves over its life.

ParticleConfig.title: ParticleConfig
ParticleConfig.description: The particle system the effect emits, when its primitive type is a real particle system rather than wrapped geometry.

Stages.title: Stages
Stages.description: The stages the effect plays over its life, each with its own trigger, timing and look.

BlendMode.title: BlendMode
BlendMode.description: How the effect is mixed with what is behind it.

PlacementMode.title: PlacementMode
PlacementMode.description: How the effect is placed against the world when it is spawned.

TintWithPlayerColor.title: TintWithPlayerColor
TintWithPlayerColor.description: Whether the effect is tinted with the colour of the player it belongs to, so two armies' effects read apart.

TargetSocket.title: TargetSocket
TargetSocket.description: The socket of the model the effect is parented to, such as a hand, a weapon tip or the model's root.

BaseTexture.title: BaseTexture
BaseTexture.description: The texture wrapped over the effect's geometry, which gives it its streaks, rings or flames.

NoiseTexture.title: NoiseTexture
NoiseTexture.description: The noise texture the effect's distortion and erosion are read from.

ProceduralMotionId.title: ProceduralMotionId
ProceduralMotionId.description: The procedural motion profile the effect's geometry is animated with.

BaseUvScroll.title: BaseUvScroll
BaseUvScroll.description: How fast the base texture scrolls across the effect's geometry.

BaseUvScale.title: BaseUvScale
BaseUvScale.description: How many times the base texture repeats over the effect's geometry.

UseFlipbook.title: UseFlipbook
UseFlipbook.description: Whether the effect is animated from a sprite sheet rather than from a scrolling texture.

FlipbookColumns.title: FlipbookColumns
FlipbookColumns.description: How many frames the sprite sheet holds across.

FlipbookRows.title: FlipbookRows
FlipbookRows.description: How many frames the sprite sheet holds down.

FlipbookFps.title: FlipbookFps
FlipbookFps.description: How many sprite sheet frames the effect plays per second.

FlipbookSubframeBlend.title: FlipbookSubframeBlend
FlipbookSubframeBlend.description: Whether two neighbouring sprite sheet frames are blended while the effect plays.

NoiseUvScroll.title: NoiseUvScroll
NoiseUvScroll.description: How fast the noise texture scrolls across the effect's geometry.

NoiseUvScale.title: NoiseUvScale
NoiseUvScale.description: How many times the noise texture repeats over the effect's geometry.

DistortionStrength.title: DistortionStrength
DistortionStrength.description: How far the noise pushes the effect's texture around, which makes a flat shape read as turbulent.

BaseColor.title: BaseColor
BaseColor.description: The main colour the effect is drawn in.

SecondaryColor.title: SecondaryColor
SecondaryColor.description: The colour blended with the main colour away from the core, which gives the effect depth.

CoreColor.title: CoreColor
CoreColor.description: The colour of the brightest part of the effect, its core.

ColorMixRatio.title: ColorMixRatio
ColorMixRatio.description: How far the effect is mixed towards its secondary colour rather than its base colour.

EmissionBoost.title: EmissionBoost
EmissionBoost.description: How strongly the effect's colours glow, which additive blending turns into brightness.

CoreThreshold.title: CoreThreshold
CoreThreshold.description: The texture value above which the effect is drawn in its core colour.

LuminanceToAlpha.title: LuminanceToAlpha
LuminanceToAlpha.description: Whether the texture's brightness is turned into the effect's opacity, which is how a black-backed flame texture becomes a flame.

LuminanceThreshold.title: LuminanceThreshold
LuminanceThreshold.description: The brightness below which the texture is fully transparent when it is turned into opacity.

LuminanceSmoothness.title: LuminanceSmoothness
LuminanceSmoothness.description: How softly the brightness-to-opacity cutoff is applied.

UseGrayscale.title: UseGrayscale
UseGrayscale.description: Whether the effect works from the grayscale brightness of its texture rather than each colour channel.

InvertMask.title: InvertMask
InvertMask.description: Whether the effect's mask is inverted, so the parts that would be hidden are the parts that are drawn.

HighPassCutoff.title: HighPassCutoff
HighPassCutoff.description: The brightness the effect's mask is cut from, which removes its dim background entirely.

EnableRadialFalloff.title: EnableRadialFalloff
EnableRadialFalloff.description: Whether the effect fades out towards the edge of its shape instead of ending in a hard outline.

RadialFalloffStart.title: RadialFalloffStart
RadialFalloffStart.description: How far out the effect stays fully drawn before its radial fade begins.

RadialFalloffEnd.title: RadialFalloffEnd
RadialFalloffEnd.description: How far out the effect has faded away completely.

EnableLengthFade.title: EnableLengthFade
EnableLengthFade.description: Whether the effect fades along its length, which lets a beam or a trail end softly.

LengthFadeStart.title: LengthFadeStart
LengthFadeStart.description: How far along its length the effect stays fully drawn before its length fade begins.

LengthFadeEnd.title: LengthFadeEnd
LengthFadeEnd.description: How far along its length the effect has faded away completely.

ErosionProgress.title: ErosionProgress
ErosionProgress.description: How much the effect has eroded away, from whole to gone.

EnableFresnel.title: EnableFresnel
EnableFresnel.description: Whether the effect brightens where it turns away from the camera, which gives an aura a glowing rim.

FresnelPower.title: FresnelPower
FresnelPower.description: How tightly the effect's rim glow hugs its silhouette.

FresnelIntensity.title: FresnelIntensity
FresnelIntensity.description: How strong the effect's rim glow is.

EnableDepthFade.title: EnableDepthFade
EnableDepthFade.description: Whether the effect fades where it cuts into the ground or another solid surface.

DepthFadeDistance.title: DepthFadeDistance
DepthFadeDistance.description: How far the effect has to be inside another surface before it has faded away.

SurfaceNormalOffset.title: SurfaceNormalOffset
SurfaceNormalOffset.description: How far the effect is lifted along the surface normal, so it does not fight the surface for the same depth.

PositionOffset.title: PositionOffset
PositionOffset.description: Where the effect sits relative to what it is attached to.

RotationOffset.title: RotationOffset
RotationOffset.description: How the effect is turned relative to what it is attached to, in degrees around each axis.

ScaleOffset.title: ScaleOffset
ScaleOffset.description: The multiplier applied to the effect's size on each axis.

Attribution_ImportedFromMap.title: Attribution_ImportedFromMap
Attribution_ImportedFromMap.description: The map the effect was imported from, kept so attribution survives a round trip through the editor.

CustomEnvironmentPresets.title: CustomEnvironmentPresets
CustomEnvironmentPresets.description: Environment presets the map adds to the engine's built-in ones, referenced by name from the default preset field or from a match setting.

items.description: One environment preset: the sun, ambient light, fog, ambient occlusion, glow and weather a match is lit with.

Id.title: Id
Id.description: The identifier the map's default preset field and a match setting name this preset by.

Name.title: Name
Name.description: The name the preset shows in a match's environment list.

IsDefault.title: IsDefault
IsDefault.description: Whether a match on this map starts with this preset when the map names none.

SunPitch.title: SunPitch
SunPitch.description: How high the sun stands, from straight overhead to below the horizon.

SunYaw.title: SunYaw
SunYaw.description: Which way the sun faces, measured around the map.

SunEnergy.title: SunEnergy
SunEnergy.description: How strongly the sun lights the battlefield.

ShadowBias.title: ShadowBias
ShadowBias.description: How far shadow samples are pushed towards the light, which trades shadow acne for a little light leaking.

ShadowNormalBias.title: ShadowNormalBias
ShadowNormalBias.description: How far shadow samples are pushed along the surface normal, which removes shadow acne on flat ground.

AmbientEnergy.title: AmbientEnergy
AmbientEnergy.description: How strongly the sky fills the shadows.

AmbientColorHex.title: AmbientColorHex
AmbientColorHex.description: The colour of the light that fills the shadows.

FogEnabled.title: FogEnabled
FogEnabled.description: Whether the map is wrapped in distance fog.

FogDensity.title: FogDensity
FogDensity.description: How thick the distance fog is, where higher hides more of the horizon.

FogColorHex.title: FogColorHex
FogColorHex.description: The colour the distance fog fades the horizon into.

SsaoEnabled.title: SsaoEnabled
SsaoEnabled.description: Whether screen-space ambient occlusion darkens the creases between models and the ground.

SsaoRadius.title: SsaoRadius
SsaoRadius.description: How far the ambient occlusion reaches from each crease.

SsaoIntensity.title: SsaoIntensity
SsaoIntensity.description: How dark the ambient occlusion makes the creases it finds.

SsaoDetail.title: SsaoDetail
SsaoDetail.description: How much fine detail the ambient occlusion keeps, rather than smoothing it away.

TonemapExposure.title: TonemapExposure
TonemapExposure.description: How bright the finished picture is exposed at.

AdjustmentContrast.title: AdjustmentContrast
AdjustmentContrast.description: How much contrast is added to the finished picture.

AdjustmentSaturation.title: AdjustmentSaturation
AdjustmentSaturation.description: How saturated the finished picture is.

GlowIntensity.title: GlowIntensity
GlowIntensity.description: How strongly bright parts of the picture bloom.

GlowBloom.title: GlowBloom
GlowBloom.description: How far the glow spreads from each bright part.

GlowStrength.title: GlowStrength
GlowStrength.description: How strong the glow is where it is applied.

CharacterFillEnergy.title: CharacterFillEnergy
CharacterFillEnergy.description: How strongly a character is filled from the front, so a unit stays readable when it stands against the sun.

WeatherType.title: WeatherType
WeatherType.description: The weather the preset runs, such as clear, rain, snow or fog.

RainParticleDensity.title: RainParticleDensity
RainParticleDensity.description: How many rain or snow particles are drawn at once. Zero turns the particles off without leaving the weather.

BaseFogDensity.title: BaseFogDensity
BaseFogDensity.description: The fog the preset's weather settles at, as opposed to the fog it starts at.

WeatherAnnouncement.title: WeatherAnnouncement
WeatherAnnouncement.description: The line the match announces to the players when the preset's weather begins.

DefaultEnvironmentPreset.title: DefaultEnvironmentPreset
DefaultEnvironmentPreset.description: The environment preset a match on this map starts with.

textures.title: textures
textures.description: Terrain swatches keyed by the name the map's terrain data and its pathing profiles refer to them by. Keys are data and are not fixed by the model.

additionalProperties.description: One terrain swatch: the texture painted onto the ground, how it is tiled and tinted, and the pathing and bombing rules the ground inherits from it.

SwatchIndex.title: SwatchIndex
SwatchIndex.description: The numbered slot the swatch is painted with in the terrain editor.

ScaleFactor.title: ScaleFactor
ScaleFactor.description: How large one tile of the texture is drawn on the ground.

TexturePath.title: TexturePath
TexturePath.description: Path to the ground texture drawn for this swatch.

TextureSize.title: TextureSize
TextureSize.description: The edge length of the texture in pixels, which the terrain shader uses to keep its noise at a fixed scale.

NoiseConfig.title: NoiseConfig
NoiseConfig.description: The noise pattern blended into the texture so a repeating tile does not read as a grid.

Brightness.title: Brightness
Brightness.description: How bright the ground painted with this swatch is.

Tint.title: Tint
Tint.description: The colour multiplied over the texture, which turns one texture into several biomes.

RoughnessScale.title: RoughnessScale
RoughnessScale.description: How rough the ground painted with this swatch reads, where higher is duller.

NormalScale.title: NormalScale
NormalScale.description: How strongly the texture's normal map bends the light on the ground.

HeightScale.title: HeightScale
HeightScale.description: How much the texture's height map displaces the ground.

HeightOffset.title: HeightOffset
HeightOffset.description: How far up or down the texture's height map sits before it is applied.

CrevicePower.title: CrevicePower
CrevicePower.description: How dark the crevices of the texture's height map are shaded.

TileMode.title: TileMode
TileMode.description: How the texture is tiled over the ground, such as a stochastic pattern that hides repetition or a plain grid.

UvScale.title: UvScale
UvScale.description: How many times the texture repeats over one world unit.

StochasticTileSize.title: StochasticTileSize
StochasticTileSize.description: The size of one stochastic tile, which decides how much variation is visible at once.

CrossFade.title: CrossFade
CrossFade.description: How softly two stochastic tiles blend where they meet.

Contrast.title: Contrast
Contrast.description: How much contrast is added to the texture when it is drawn.

Saturation.title: Saturation
Saturation.description: How much saturation is added to the texture when it is drawn.

Specular.title: Specular
Specular.description: How shiny the ground painted with this swatch reads.

Roughness.title: Roughness
Roughness.description: How rough the ground's specular highlight is.

Metallic.title: Metallic
Metallic.description: How metallic the ground reads, which tints its reflections with its own colour.

DefaultPathingCode.title: DefaultPathingCode
DefaultPathingCode.description: The pathing the ground inherits from this swatch, declared as named bits.

DecalBombingRules.title: DecalBombingRules
DecalBombingRules.description: The decals scattered over ground painted with this swatch, such as grass tufts or gravel.

items.description: One rule that scatters decals of a given template over ground painted with a swatch, with the spread of size, angle and tint each one is given.

VfxBombingRules.title: VfxBombingRules
VfxBombingRules.description: The visual effects scattered over ground painted with this swatch, such as drifting embers or pollen.

items.description: One rule that scatters visual effects of a given template over ground painted with a swatch, with the spread of size and the distance each is lifted from the ground.

Attribution_ImportedFromMap.title: Attribution_ImportedFromMap
Attribution_ImportedFromMap.description: The map the texture was imported from, kept so attribution survives a round trip through the editor.

decals.title: decals
decals.description: Decal templates keyed by the name a texture's bombing rules or a placed decal refers to them by. Keys are data and are not fixed by the model.

additionalProperties.description: One decal template: the picture projected onto the ground and everything about how it is tinted, lit, faded and animated.

Tint.title: Tint
Tint.description: The colour multiplied over the decal image.

Brightness.title: Brightness
Brightness.description: How bright the decal is drawn.

Contrast.title: Contrast
Contrast.description: How much contrast the decal is drawn with.

Saturation.title: Saturation
Saturation.description: How saturated the decal is drawn.

Opacity.title: Opacity
Opacity.description: How opaque the decal is. Zero makes it invisible.

AlbedoMix.title: AlbedoMix
AlbedoMix.description: How much of the ground's own colour shows through the decal, from the decal alone to the ground alone.

NormalStrength.title: NormalStrength
NormalStrength.description: How strongly the decal's normal map bends the light on the ground under it.

Roughness.title: Roughness
Roughness.description: How rough the ground reads under the decal.

Metallic.title: Metallic
Metallic.description: How metallic the ground reads under the decal.

BlendMode.title: BlendMode
BlendMode.description: How the decal is mixed with the ground, such as alpha blending or additive glow.

TextureNormal.title: TextureNormal
TextureNormal.description: Path to the decal's normal map, which gives the ground under it a raised or sunken look.

TextureOrm.title: TextureOrm
TextureOrm.description: Path to the decal's packed occlusion, roughness and metallic map.

TextureEmission.title: TextureEmission
TextureEmission.description: Path to the decal's emission map, which is the part of it that glows.

EmissionEnergy.title: EmissionEnergy
EmissionEnergy.description: How strongly the decal's emission glows.

AnimateOpacity.title: AnimateOpacity
AnimateOpacity.description: Whether the decal's opacity pulses over time, which is how a torch's light pool flickers.

OpacityPulseSpeed.title: OpacityPulseSpeed
OpacityPulseSpeed.description: How fast the decal's opacity pulses.

MinOpacity.title: MinOpacity
MinOpacity.description: The lowest opacity the decal's pulse reaches.

MaxOpacity.title: MaxOpacity
MaxOpacity.description: The highest opacity the decal's pulse reaches.

AnimateEmission.title: AnimateEmission
AnimateEmission.description: Whether the decal's glow pulses over time.

EmissionPulseSpeed.title: EmissionPulseSpeed
EmissionPulseSpeed.description: How fast the decal's glow pulses.

MinEmission.title: MinEmission
MinEmission.description: The lowest glow the decal's pulse reaches.

MaxEmission.title: MaxEmission
MaxEmission.description: The highest glow the decal's pulse reaches.

AnimateScale.title: AnimateScale
AnimateScale.description: Whether the decal grows and shrinks over time, which is how a spreading pool of light moves.

ScalePulseSpeed.title: ScalePulseSpeed
ScalePulseSpeed.description: How fast the decal's size pulses.

MinScaleRatio.title: MinScaleRatio
MinScaleRatio.description: The smallest size the decal's pulse reaches, as a fraction of its placed size.

MaxScaleRatio.title: MaxScaleRatio
MaxScaleRatio.description: The largest size the decal's pulse reaches, as a fraction of its placed size.

UpperFade.title: UpperFade
UpperFade.description: How far up a vertical surface the decal fades out, so it does not stop in a hard line where the ground climbs.

LowerFade.title: LowerFade
LowerFade.description: How far down a vertical surface the decal fades out.

PlacementMode.title: PlacementMode
PlacementMode.description: How the decal is anchored to the world, such as snapped to the surface under it or projected from above.

ProjectionSize.title: ProjectionSize
ProjectionSize.description: The width of the area the decal is projected onto when its placement mode projects from above.

ProjectionHeight.title: ProjectionHeight
ProjectionHeight.description: How far above the ground the decal is projected from.

GroundOffset.title: GroundOffset
GroundOffset.description: How far above the ground the decal is lifted, so it does not fight with the terrain for the same depth.

NormalFade.title: NormalFade
NormalFade.description: How sharply the decal fades where the surface under it turns away from the projection direction.

DistanceFadeEnabled.title: DistanceFadeEnabled
DistanceFadeEnabled.description: Whether the decal fades out as the camera pulls away instead of staying equally strong at every zoom.

DistanceFadeBegin.title: DistanceFadeBegin
DistanceFadeBegin.description: How far the camera has to be before the decal starts to fade.

DistanceFadeEnd.title: DistanceFadeEnd
DistanceFadeEnd.description: How far the camera has to be before the decal has faded away completely.

Columns.title: Columns
Columns.description: How many frames the sheet holds across.

Rows.title: Rows
Rows.description: How many frames the sheet holds down.

Fps.title: Fps
Fps.description: How many frames the sheet plays per second.

SubframeBlend.title: SubframeBlend
SubframeBlend.description: Whether two neighbouring frames are blended while the effect plays, so a fast sheet does not read as a slide show.

TexturePath.title: TexturePath
TexturePath.description: Path to the sprite sheet texture the frames are cut from.

SpawnShader.title: SpawnShader
SpawnShader.description: Spawn shaders keyed by the name a placeable's spawn shader field refers to them by. Keys are data and are not fixed by the model.

additionalProperties.description: One spawn shader: the materialising effect played where a placeable appears or dies, from where it starts to how long it takes.

Name.title: Name
Name.description: The name the spawn shader shows in the editor.

TransitionMode.title: TransitionMode
TransitionMode.description: How the shader reveals the model, such as rising from the ground or dissolving into it.

Direction.title: Direction
Direction.description: Which way the reveal travels across the model, such as upwards, downwards or outwards.

EdgeColor.title: EdgeColor
EdgeColor.description: The colour of the glowing edge of the reveal.

EdgeWidth.title: EdgeWidth
EdgeWidth.description: How wide the glowing edge of the reveal is.

EdgeEmission.title: EdgeEmission
EdgeEmission.description: How strongly the edge of the reveal glows.

NoiseScale.title: NoiseScale
NoiseScale.description: The size of the noise the reveal is broken up with.

NoiseRoughness.title: NoiseRoughness
NoiseRoughness.description: How harsh the noise the reveal is broken up with reads.

FresnelPower.title: FresnelPower
FresnelPower.description: How tightly the model's rim glow hugs its silhouette while it materialises.

VertexDisplacement.title: VertexDisplacement
VertexDisplacement.description: How far the model's vertices are pushed apart while it materialises.

AlphaFade.title: AlphaFade
AlphaFade.description: How much the model fades as it appears. One fades from invisible; zero never fades.

Duration.title: Duration
Duration.description: How long the reveal takes from start to finish.

AssetType.title: AssetType
AssetType.description: The asset category the spawn shader is filed under, which decides where the editor lists it.

Contributors.title: Contributors
Contributors.description: Everybody whose work this map carries, gathered from the authors of the assets it ships and of the assets it imported. It is written when the map is signed.

Attributions.title: Attributions
Attributions.description: The same authors ordered by how much of the imported content each one contributed, most first, so the credit a map shows matches what it borrowed. It is written when the map is signed.

EngineVersion.title: EngineVersion
EngineVersion.description: The engine binary that published this map, which the registry reports beside the map. It is written when the map is signed.

author_key.title: author_key
author_key.description: The public half of the authorship key that signed this map, stored so the claim can be checked against the signature. It is written when the map is signed.

signature.title: signature
signature.description: The authorship signature over this map's metadata as it stood before signing, base64 encoded. It is written when the map is signed and dropped by every other save, because a save changes the bytes it covers.
